evidence_quotes.O: From the piano black finish to the tasteful, blue, glowing bar and sweet blue light coming out of the ports.
evidence_quotes.C: The power supply is a HEFTY 3A output. It will power all 7 ports at 428mA each or 6 at 500mA each.
evidence_quotes.E: This is the stuff dreams are made of: If you need lots of storage for your images, this is the card to buy.
evidence_quotes.A: The people in my office liked its looks so much that we bought one for everyone in the office.
evidence_quotes.N: This is a bonus in my book because I dislike having to open a clam-shell with a knife or scissors, it is frustrating.
